    input wire send,

);

        if (reset) begin
            frame_sent <= 0;
            state <= 0; // Start in waiting state
        end else begin
            case (state)
                0: begin // Waiting for ACK
                    frame_sent <= 0;
                    if (send) begin
                        frame_sent <= 1; // Send frame
                        state <= 1; // Move to sending state
                    end
                end
                1: begin // Sending frame
                    if (ack) begin
                        state <= 0; // Return to waiting state upon ACK
                    end
                end
                default: state <= 0; // Reset to waiting state
            endcase
        end
    end
endmodule

module serializer(

    input reset,
    input start,
    input [15:0] parallel_in,
    output reg serial_out,

);

    reg [15:0] data; // Register to hold the input data

    always @(posedge clk or posedge reset) begin
        if (reset) begin
            count <= 0;
            serial_out <= 0;

            if (count == 15) begin
                done <= 1; // Set done when last bit is sent
            end else begin
                done <= 0;
            end
        end
    end
endmodule
